sources.title: Qwen3-ASR-1.7B — vllm-ascend
sources.snippet: Qwen3-ASR-1.7B is a 1.7B-parameter automatic speech recognition (ASR) model from the Qwen team. It supports Chinese and English speech, Chinese dialects, multilingual speech, and singing voice transcription, and provides long-audio and streaming inference capabilities.
